description: Still water in a closed tank 0.6 m x 0.6 m (dx 0.01 m), depth 0.3037 m (the surface inside a cell), a refined box over 3 levels (x 0.2-0.4, z 0.2-0.4) whose sides run through the surface; the single phase (F 41 1, F 66 0.05, F 67 2) with G 18 1: the coarse value at the fine cells of the patch edges from the water, with the ghost values of the ghost fluid method for the neighbours in the air (pr_weights).
